Make two small fixes in `/Users/jaronswab/go/src/github.com/jrswab/axe/internal/tool/write_file.go`:

## Fix 1: Update the static "artifact" field description (around line 82)

Current:
```go
"artifact": {
    Type:        "string",
    Required:    false,
    Description: `When "true", write to the artifact directory instead of the working directory.`,
},
```

Change to:
```go
"artifact": {
    Type:        "string",
    Required:    false,
    Description: `When "true", write to the artifact directory; when "false", write to the working directory. If omitted, respects the agent-level default_write setting.`,
},
```

This informs the LLM about the escape hatch (passing "false" to override default_write=true) and the fallback behavior.

## Fix 2: Remove the redundant `!useArtifact` check (around line 103)

Current:
```go
artifactArg := call.Arguments["artifact"]
useArtifact := strings.EqualFold(artifactArg, "true")
if !useArtifact && artifactArg == "" && ec.DefaultArtifactWrite {
    useArtifact = true
}
```

Change to:
```go
artifactArg := call.Arguments["artifact"]
useArtifact := strings.EqualFold(artifactArg, "true")
if artifactArg == "" && ec.DefaultArtifactWrite {
    useArtifact = true
}
```

This is a pure refactor with zero behavioral change: when `artifactArg == "true"`, `useArtifact` is already `true` and the if-block's condition `artifactArg == ""` is false, so `!useArtifact` was redundant.

Do NOT change anything else. After making the edits, verify the code compiles by running: `go build ./internal/tool/...`
